protocol.purpose: Exploratory paired comparison on already disclosed synthetic v5. Not a new blinded test or real-data validation.

hypotheses.prize: В тексте говорится о розыгрыше приза.
hypotheses.payment: В тексте сказано, что участие платное.
hypotheses.random: В тексте сказано, что победителя выбирают случайно.
hypotheses.free: В тексте сказано, что участие бесплатно.
hypotheses.judged: В тексте сказано, что победителя выбирает жюри.

protocol.decision: Documented zero-shot independent normalization: entailment/(entailment+contradiction). Positive threshold0.7 with raw entailment>=0.3 and entailment>neutral. Negative threshold0.8 with raw entailment>=0.5. Hybrid retains all baselinehigh, blocks promotions on explicit free/warning/contradictions; otherwise each core can be supported by a baseline signal or positive NLI. Three core→high, two→medium, otherwise baseline priority. No production engine replacement in this experiment.
protocol.adoptionGate: Do not replace baseline unless paired macro F1 and high recall improve without materially increasing false positives. Independent unseen and human evaluation still required.
protocol.limits: Max512tokens per text-hypothesis pair; truncation logged. No protected user materials, only previously authored synthetic benchmark.
protocol.predecessor: Two raw NLI threshold experiments failed; preserved. This protocol uses the documented entailment-vs-contradiction zero-shot normalization and simpler source-claim hypotheses. Calibration used only two literal developer control examples, no v5 case-specific fixes.

scope: Exploratory fixed-protocol comparison on previously disclosed synthetic v5; not a fresh independent benchmark, human annotation, real corpus, or production accuracy.

performance.scope: CPU inference of six NLI hypotheses per complete concatenated synthetic case, two intra-op threads. Excludes browser runtime, OCR and user storage.

limitations: Same disclosed v5 dataset used by product team; no unseen-data claim.
NLI pretrained on another task. Scores are not calibrated fraud probabilities.
Kazakh and transliteration task performance is unvalidated.
A model does not verify source ownership, authenticity or permission.
